title: mut.channel_tyler_hobbs
mutation_directive: Channel Tyler Hobbs (Fidenza / Subscapes). Replace whatever motion exists with a structured, hand-tuned flow field — particles flow along clearly visible streamlines that DON'T overlap (use collision detection or domain partitioning so streams don't cross). Composition matters: leave significant negative space, group particles into 5-8 distinct color regions. Palette: warm earth tones (raw umber, terracotta, ochre, oxide red) with one cool accent. The piece should look like an OIL PAINTING that happens to be code, not a digital effect.
